objective: Improve full-denominator native ContextBench source acquisition and Span-F1 at bounded total model cost, then establish superiority only through a new matched comparator and untouched confirmation.
hypothesis: One bounded issue-conditioned GLM query-expansion step reaches useful source vocabulary missed by the static issue-clause ranker, without repeated workspace-maintenance calls.

selection_evidence.dominant_gap: Workspace mean missing span coverage .60837 before acquisition versus .09218 acquired-but-unselected. Citation repair alone is not selected as the next quality mechanism.
selection_evidence.distinction_from_failed_policies: Model-generated issue-conditioned vocabulary, not generic region pooling, graph connectivity, import neighbors or cross-encoder reranking. Those failures remain unchanged.

construction_boundary.authority: Existing owner-directed private G02 research/development and GLM approval; no product admission or activation.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Implement and test a bounded public-JSON query planner and source-only candidate projector; then freeze a cheap exposed acquisition screen.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: Existing clean WSL source/evidence bases and VPS-only GLM credentials; the separately tested r2 SSH-reuse transport must be prospectively bound for this new screen.
deferred_residue: Untouched confirmation admission with public-example exposure ledger

frozen_screen_contract.cohort: All12 already-exposed r11/matched-r1 cases, original ascending order; no case replacement or confirmation opening.
frozen_screen_contract.model: glm-5.3-flash, original fixed relay and low thinking
frozen_screen_contract.generator_inputs: Original issue text only, bounded before dispatch. No reference labels, patches, historical scores, predicted selections, hidden reasoning or credentials.
frozen_screen_contract.generator_output: Strict public JSON containing one to three short search-query strings, each at most160 characters. Search leads are speculative, not source claims.
frozen_screen_contract.candidate_projection: Use the exact archived source ranker query primitive on the pinned base. At most three source intervals per case; source existence, bounds and hashes verified. Deduplicate exact path/range identities and preserve original leads in comparison.
frozen_screen_contract.exposure_barrier: Seal every attempted generator output and source-lead prediction before any screen label load. Preserve invalid outputs and unknown usage as failures; no retry or favourable-case exclusion.
frozen_screen_contract.comparison: Archived base-ranker primer on original issue versus generated queries; both exclude all previously observed control paths. Three allocated slots per case, at most17 lines each. Nonempty paired slots have exact min-width matching; empty treatment slots remain failures and controls are retained.
frozen_screen_contract.claim_ceiling: Acquisition-screen evidence only. Even a passed proxy gate cannot advance native quality or support superiority.
stop_conditions: Unknown generation usage or uncertain dispatch
No positive full-denominator source-acquisition advantage over the frozen control

execution_evidence.generation_phase: All12 issue-only query outputs are valid and sealed;5253 known generation tokens, zero retries. All12 source-lead seals were verified before scoring; execution is terminal, not live.
execution_evidence.decision: Reject advancement of this exact policy; no full native campaign or superiority claim. Preserve the frozen thresholds and complete denominator.
execution_evidence.index_attribution: The separate source-only index replay reproduces all12 archived counts before labels. Of39 reference occurrences,37 are indexed; of21 novel reference occurrences,19 are indexed. Missing admission alone therefore does not explain the low source reach. This attribution is not proof of ranking causality.
execution_evidence.control_posture: Historical observed paths only define screening novelty and never enter the generator. The unexpanded proxy control is not a new native-engine comparator. A future live policy must use its own observation ledger, not historical task-specific path filters.
execution_evidence.native_inference_budget: If this screen qualifies, reserve planner generation and tokens inside the same total per-case native budget; no unaccounted extra calls. Exact integration is a separately frozen subsequent native experiment.

construction_evidence.scope: Synthetic planner/reply/source validation only; not source-acquisition, native quality or superiority evidence.
construction_evidence.source_host_prerequisite: The screen host must verify tracked files against the exact frozen Git base before providing them to the pure projector. Digest equality in the projector alone is not base provenance.
construction_evidence.index_posture: Retain archived ranker indexed/omitted-file counts and partial-index flag; query expansion does not silently broaden the 64MiB/1MiB-per-file index or claim a complete repository search.
construction_evidence.projection_width: The prototype normalizes leads to at most17 source lines, matching the ranker's original bounded local intervals. Exact per-slot width/cardinality matching is owned by the prospective screen control, not proven by these tests.

continuation_dag.action: Implement bounded planner/projector and synthetic no-provider tests.
Bind all12 exposed tasks, sources, r2 transport, budgets, equal-width control and exact proxy gate before requests.
Generate once per case and seal all predictions before isolated exposed label analysis.
Reject cheaply if no acquisition advantage; otherwise prospectively freeze a full new native matched campaign.
Test the qualified policy with fresh control, balanced arm order, equal total per-case model budgets and unchanged native quality/cost thresholds, counting planner calls.
Only after native advancement, freeze new matched DSH and untouched confirmation before blinded execution and reviewer claims.
